content.short: Dash has focused on payments since 2014, with masternodes for instant confirmations and a treasury that funds its own development.
content.description: Dash started as a fork of Bitcoin's code and added a second layer of bonded masternodes. They enable InstantSend payments that confirm in seconds, optional CoinJoin privacy and onchain governance. Around a tenth of each block reward goes to a treasury, and masternode owners vote on which proposals it funds. Dash Platform adds usernames and decentralized data storage for consumer apps. DashPay is its consumer wallet, and the project offers a merchant kit for shops that want to accept Dash for payments that cost less than a cent.
content.meta: Digital cash with instant payments, masternode governance and a self-funding treasury. Explore Dash on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
